title: ISO 9660 CD-ROM image signature
summary: An ISO 9660 image has 'CD001' (0x43 0x44 0x30 0x30 0x31) at offset 32769 (sector 16, offset 1) of the primary volume descriptor.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: Primary volume descriptor at sector 16 (offset 32768): type 0x01, then 'CD001', version 0x01.
ISO 9660 is the standard filesystem for CD-ROMs.
Extensions: Rock Ridge (Unix), Joliet (Windows long filenames), UDF (DVD/Blu-ray).
